answers.products: Our catalogue includes IV infusion sets, IV cannulas, syringes, blood transfusion sets, medical gloves and measured-volume sets. Choose a category to learn more.
answers.bulk: For a bulk enquiry, share the product, quantity, specifications and destination country. Our team needs to confirm availability and supply options. There is no online checkout.
answers.documents: Specifications, materials, sizes and product documents need to be confirmed for the specific model. Ask the team for the documentation your organisation requires.
answers.contact: You can send a product or business enquiry using our contact form. This guide is automated and cannot connect you to a live agent.
answers.shipping: Delivery options, lead times and market eligibility are confirmed individually. Include your destination in your enquiry; this website does not guarantee supply to a particular country.

items.q: Can I place an order on this website?
items.a: No. This is an information and enquiry website. Browse a product, then use the contact form to discuss your requirements with KS.

items.q: Where can I find sizes and technical specifications?
items.a: Send a product enquiry with the specifications you need. The team must confirm model-specific sizes, materials, packaging and documentation.

items.q: Can I enquire about bulk quantities?
items.a: Yes. Include your estimated quantity, destination and relevant specifications. Availability, lead times and any commercial terms are confirmed separately.
The catalogue, enquiry form and automated guide are available in English, Arabic, Persian and Turkish. Use the language selector in the header.

privacyPage.title: Privacy, in plain language.
privacyPage.intro: This preview describes the intended enquiry workflow. Before launch, the website owner must publish the legal business identity, privacy contact and a specific retention schedule.

sections.title: Information you choose to share
sections.text: The enquiry form requests your name, email, destination, product interest and message, with optional organisation, phone and quantity. Please do not submit patient data or sensitive medical information.

sections.title: How enquiries are handled
sections.text: When configured, the form sends your enquiry to KS’s designated inbox through Cloudflare Pages Functions and Resend. These service providers process the submitted information to deliver and protect the service. The preview does not send messages.

sections.title: Browser storage and the catalogue guide
sections.text: Your language preference may be saved on your device. If you change languages while completing the form, a temporary draft is held in session storage and removed when restored or submitted. Chat messages stay in the current browser page and are not sent to an AI provider.

sections.title: Fonts and security services
sections.text: The website requests typefaces from Google Fonts; your browser connects to Google to load them. When configured, Cloudflare Turnstile checks form submissions to reduce automated abuse. No marketing analytics or advertising trackers are included in this build.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.text: Submitting an enquiry is optional. You can clear browser storage at any time. For questions about an enquiry already sent, use the contact form to request information or deletion. A dedicated privacy contact and legally appropriate retention and rights information must be added before public launch.
